entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana with VeloFit customer support. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana. I need to start a return for an order I received last week.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
Sure, the name is Alex Smith, and the order number is VF78-9901B.

Thank you, Alex. I see the order here for the VeloFit Aero-Tech jersey. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
It's a preference, I suppose. I ordered my usual medium, but this jersey is just the wrong size for me. It's way too tight across the chest. I'd like to set up an exchange for a large if possible.

I understand completely. Getting the right fit is key. Let me just check the delivery date... Okay, I see it was delivered 6 days ago. Our policy for apparel is 10 days, so you are unfortunately outside the window. I can absolutely process that exchange for you right away.

That's great news. Now, since I do have to package this up and send it back, I was wondering if you could offer a small discount code for the inconvenience. It would make me feel a bit better about the process.

I appreciate you asking, Alex. While our policy doesn't allow for discount codes on sizing exchanges, I can confirm that the return shipping is completely covered by VeloFit. I'm generating a pre-paid shipping label for you right now, which you should receive by email in the next few minutes.
Okay, free return shipping is fair. I can accept that. Thank you for clarifying.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the original jersey, we'll ship out the size large to you immediately. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks for your help, Diana.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
